PLANS.IMMUTABILITY_TITLE: Plans cannot be modified after creation
PLANS.IMMUTABILITY_BODY: Once a plan is linked to a payout calculation, it is locked forever. This is intentional: if the rules could change retroactively, every commission already paid under that plan would be incorrect. What you define here is what payees get paid on — permanently.

PLANS.CONFIRM_ARCHIVE_MSG: Archiving this plan will make it read-only. This action cannot be undone easily.
PLANS.RULES_EMPTY_DESC: Add compensation rules to define how payouts are calculated.
PLANS.ASSIGNMENTS_EMPTY_DESC: Assignments are managed from the Assignments page.
PLANS.HINT_RATE_UNITS: Enter as monetary amount, e.g. 2.00 = €2.00 per unit
PLANS.UNITS_RATE_TABLE_NOTE: Units measurement uses Flat rate only.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_SPLIT_AT_QUOTA: When enabled, the transaction revenue is split at the quota boundary: the portion up to quota earns the lower tier rate, and the excess above quota earns the accelerated tier rate. When disabled, a single bracket rate applies based on overall attainment.
PLANS.CONFIRM_DELETE_RULE_MSG: Are you sure you want to delete this rule? This cannot be undone.
PLANS.COND_OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL: is greater than or equal to
PLANS.COND_OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL: is less than or equal to
PLANS.TOOLTIP_SORT_ORDER: Controls the order in which rules are evaluated. Lower numbers run first. Use this to ensure dependent rules execute in the right sequence.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_MEASUREMENT_TYPE: What gets measured from each transaction: Revenue (monetary amount), Units (quantity sold), Margin (profit), Attainment (% of quota reached), or Custom.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_SOURCE_FIELD: The exact field name from the transaction data used for this measurement. For example: "amount" for the sale value, "units" for quantity.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_AGGREGATION: How multiple transactions are combined: Sum adds all values together, Average takes the mean, Max uses the highest value, Min uses the lowest, Count totals the number of transactions.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_RATE_TABLE_TYPE: Flat: one fixed rate applies to the whole amount. Tiered: different rates apply to different amount ranges. Attainment: rates are determined by the % of quota achieved.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_FLAT_RATE_UNITS: The amount earned per unit sold. Example: 2.00 means €2.00 commission for each unit in the transaction.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_TRIGGER: If enabled, this rule only applies when the conditions are met. Without a trigger, the rule always runs on every matching transaction.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_LOGICAL_OP: AND: every condition must be true for the rule to activate. OR: the rule activates if at least one condition is true.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_MODIFIER: If enabled, the final commission is multiplied by the factor you set. Useful for accelerators, bonuses, or SPIFFs on top of the base commission.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_MODIFIER_FACTOR: The multiplier applied to the calculated commission. 1.5 = 150% (50% bonus). 2.0 = double commission. 0.5 = half commission.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_CAP_AMOUNT: The maximum commission this rule can generate. Earnings above this limit are cut off. Useful for controlling payout risk.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_CAP_SCOPE: Per Transaction: cap applied to each individual transaction. Per Period: total cap across the entire pay period. Per Payee per Period: individual cap per rep per period.
PLANS.TOOLTIP_FLOOR_AMOUNT: The minimum guaranteed commission from this rule, regardless of actual performance. Ensures a baseline payout even if the calculated amount is lower.
PLANS.RULE_READONLY_NOTICE: This rule belongs to an active or archived plan and cannot be modified. To make changes, clone the plan as a new draft version.
PLANS.RULE_IMMUTABILITY_TITLE: Rules cannot be modified after the plan activates
PLANS.RULE_IMMUTABILITY_BODY: Once this plan processes any transaction, its rules are locked forever. Commission logic is permanent — what you define here is what payees earn on, with no retroactive edits.
PLANS.DETAIL_NO_RULES_READONLY: This plan has no rules. To add rules, clone it as a new draft version.

TWO_FACTOR.HEADING: Two-Factor Authentication
TWO_FACTOR.ENABLED_DESC: Your account is protected with an authenticator app.
TWO_FACTOR.DISABLED_DESC: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
TWO_FACTOR.SETUP_INSTRUCTION: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, etc.), or enter the secret manually.
TWO_FACTOR.CONFIRM_HINT: After scanning, enter the 6-digit code your app shows to confirm setup.
TWO_FACTOR.SETUP_ERROR: Could not load setup data. Please try again.
TWO_FACTOR.RECOVERY_CODES_WARNING: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each code can only be used once. If you lose your authenticator device, these are the only way back in.
TWO_FACTOR.DISABLE_INSTRUCTION: To disable 2FA, confirm your password and enter a code from your authenticator app.
TWO_FACTOR.DISABLE_ERROR: Could not disable 2FA. Please check your password and code.
TWO_FACTOR.REGEN_INSTRUCTION: This will invalidate your existing recovery codes. Confirm your password and enter a code from your app.
TWO_FACTOR.REGEN_ERROR: Could not regenerate codes. Please check your password and code.
TWO_FACTOR.VERIFY_SUBTITLE: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app for
TWO_FACTOR.RECOVERY_SUBTITLE: Enter one of your recovery codes for
TWO_FACTOR.INVALID_CODE: Invalid or expired code. Please try again.
TWO_FACTOR.INFO_PRIMARY: A second login step adds an additional layer of security to protect your account even when your password is compromised. To enable it, all you need is a mobile device.
TWO_FACTOR.INFO_SECONDARY: Two-step verification only works if you log in with your username and password. If you use other login methods, we recommend authentication apps such as Duo or Google Authenticator.
TWO_FACTOR.SETUP_WHAT_DESC: An extra step at sign-in: after your password, you enter a short code from an app on your phone. Even if someone gets your password, they still can't access your account without your device — important in Wasnie, where real compensation data is at stake.
TWO_FACTOR.SETUP_STEP1_DESC: We recommend Microsoft Authenticator (free). Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password and any TOTP-compatible app also work.
TWO_FACTOR.SETUP_STEP2_DESC: Open the app, tap 'Add account' and point your camera at the code. No camera? Use the manual key instead.
TWO_FACTOR.SETUP_STEP3_DESC: Your app generates a new code every 30 seconds — that's normal. Enter the current one to finish.
TWO_FACTOR.REMINDER_BODY: Two-factor authentication adds a second step at sign-in — your account stays safe even if your password is ever compromised. It only takes a minute to set up.
